summary: Iteration 5 verifies the 4 new features on Fayr Ops Desk: (1) Department permissions, (2) Staff Management CRUD, (3) Password reset flow, (4) AI daily rate limit. BACKEND: 13/13 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_permissions_and_staff.py (admin can access all, operations only /claims, support only /tickets, unauthenticated 401, staff list admin-only, staff CRUD create/update/delete/persist, dup-email 400, short-password 400, cannot delete self, cannot demote/delete last admin, forgot-password returns generic 200 for both existing+non-existing emails, reset-password with bogus token -> 400, reset with <8 chars -> 400, single AI call still 200 with enforce_ai_limit dependency). FRONTEND: 100% pass — forgot-password link on Login navigates to /forgot-password, forgot-submit shows forgot-sent confirmation for support@fayr.in, /reset-password?token=bogus renders reset-password-page and submitting shows reset-error 'This reset link is invalid or has already been used' (backend returned 400 as expected); admin (prakash.tamang@cashkaro.com) sidebar shows all 6 sections (ai, customer_support, operations, frontend_ops, finance, admin); support (support@fayr.in) sidebar shows ONLY ai + customer_support, and navigating to /finance auto-redirects to /assistant (default section); StaffManager on /admin loads 4 users, Add teammate dialog + Select-in-dialog works (added TEST_ finance user), inline role-change select persists (support -> operations), delete confirmation dialog removes the row and toast 'Teammate removed' displayed.

issues: Recurring console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — ResponsiveContainer paints before parent has size; carry-over from iteration 4.
Radix warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — a11y minor; add DialogDescription for the add-teammate dialog and staff-delete-dialog.

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription to add-staff-dialog and staff-delete-dialog to silence Radix warnings.
Optional: fix ResponsiveContainer sizing on Admin metrics (recharts width/height=-1). Carry-over from iteration 4.

Cleanup: one leftover staff row (test_ui_<ts>@fayr.in, Finance) from an intermediate UI run; auto-created via /api/staff but not deleted before viewport update. Safe to remove manually from Team Management.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py section_for_path correctly routes /ai/* under ai section which SECTION_ROLES gates to {support} (+admin short-circuit). Frontend ROLE_SECTIONS['support'] includes 'ai' and 'customer_support' — matches backend.
delete_staff correctly blocks self-delete AND last-admin removal; update_staff also blocks demoting last admin. Verified by tests.
forgot-password intentionally returns a generic success even for unknown emails — prevents user enumeration. Good.
enforce_ai_limit uses find_one_and_update with $inc + upsert and checks post-increment count > AI_DAILY_LIMIT — atomic and correct.
public_router is mounted WITHOUT authorize_request, so /auth/forgot-password and /auth/reset-password are truly public. Correct.
StaffManager component has all required data-testids and handles error toasts via errText helper — good testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (forgot-password page, reset-password error, admin full sidebar, support filtered sidebar + redirect from disallowed route, staff CRUD dialog/select/role-change/delete-confirm)

test_credentials: Admin prakash.tamang@cashkaro.com/Fayr@Admin2026, Support support@fayr.in/Support@2026, Operations ops1@fayr.in/OpsPass2026 — all verified working.
seed_data_creation: Test file creates & deletes TEST_staff_it5@fayr.in per test run; one orphan test_ui_<ts>@fayr.in remains from the first UI attempt (delete confirmed working on the second attempt).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-5 features (permissions, staff CRUD, password reset, AI limit) are all green. Only outstanding pre-existing issues carried over: (a) brute-force lockout ingress-IP problem from iteration 4 (see iteration_4.json rca), (b) Recharts width/height warnings, (c) missing DialogDescription a11y warnings. Regression test suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, test_auth.py, test_ai_agent.py, and new test_permissions_and_staff.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found in this iteration.
